page.layout: One printed page on the scan (the right edge is a neighbouring page and is not transcribed). Running head at top with the title and the book division. Page number at top left. One text column, full width, with an empty left margin and no notes. Catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: ra, vel potiùs naturæ sator, Deus, ita ad obedientiam subditorum corda finxerit, colla flexerit, vt licet eorum Rex Leges pariter diuinas & humanas spreuerit, cœlum & terram sua grassatione miscuerit, omnia turbauerit; tantùm tamen absunt à violentas manus ei injiciendo, vt in injicientes ipsi statim suas injiciant. Neque certè ego Regicidis tormentum optarem exquisitius, quàm vt effrenis populi libidini & furori dimittantur, cùm nihil eorum conscientias acriùs pungat aut lancinet intimiùs, quàm cum se ab iis, quorum se liberatores venditant derelictos videant, imò eorum linguis confossos, laceratos manibus, pedibus calcatos; & certè à testibus fide dignis accepi Franciscum Rauillac, illum incarnatum Dæmonem, Henrici quarti fœlicis memoriæ infaustum percussorem, magis attonitos & anxios ostendisse vultus ad execrationes, quas in eum plenis faucibus e[?]uomuit circumfusa multitudo, quàm ad aspectum aut sensum igniti forcipis aut plumbi, & sulphuris ar-dentis.

page.notes: No marginal notes on this page. "cuomuit" in the fourth-last line is uncertain; the first letter could be an "e" or "c" and the word may be "evomuit", so it is marked [?]. The right edge of the scan shows part of the next printed page, which is not transcribed. Long s was normalised to s and u/v, i/j spelling was normalised as instructed.
